goal: Python existence-check only (Yahoo quote or search listings). Scaffold the typed ticker with quote_symbol null. Orchestrator confirms the listing with tools, stamps quote_symbol, and verify_listing.py must quote it. No hardcoded map, no API-key judge, no abort_match remap.
non_goals: Do not mutate archive/research or archive/outcomes history
Do not auto-rename the archive folder to a different issuer (APPL must not become AAPL)
Do not add per-ticker Yahoo maps
Do not call xAI HTTP or XAI_API_KEY for ticker identity
success_criteria: harness/VERSION is 2.26.0 in the same change set
No YAHOO_SYMBOL_MAP / alias_candidates / abort_match suggestion UI
check_ticker statuses are quoted | search_evidence | aborts; no quote_symbol on TickerCheck
scaffold writes quote_symbol null; orchestrator is the only writer of a confirmed listing
verify_listing.py quotes the stamp; fail closed if missing
quote_symbol_from_session does not fall back to ticker
Analyze prompt does not leak Yahoo search hits
